# ST_SNN

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A spiking neural network that integrates spatial convolution and temporal dynamics, designed for event-driven neuromorphic processing. Enables efficient hardware acceleration on memristor networks for real-time sensory data like DVS events, critical for in-network neuromorphic computing.
